bio: A spacious and modern restaurant just a few steps from the Plaza de Zaragoza that is full every day – a success based on its simple motto of “rice and grilled dishes”. Its interior, a mix of the rustic and contemporary, provides the backdrop for its famous rice dishes (for a minimum of two people) and grilled options ranging from fish fresh from the market and top-quality cuts of meat. The à la carte is complemented by an impressive array of specials, including a variety of stews and seafood options....
